subject: Vendor onboarding: split allocations, PO issuance and SKU itemization
messages:
From: Jacqueline Vega <jacqueline@clearedge.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding — allocation and PO guidance

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the quick intro earlier. Attached is our completed onboarding form and a SKU catalog export so your procurement team can map items to Redwood's ledger. A few quick notes so we don't block the onboarding flow: 

- We're doing a staged activation: initial pilot spend of $15k, then full activation up to $45k after pilot acceptance. Can Redwood issue provisional PO(s) scoped to those bands?
- In the catalog the product codes use vendor_SKU IDs; if you need your internal item codes we can supply a remap file.
- We noticed Redwood's sample invoice template wants separate line items by usage type; we can split on our side but wanted to confirm expected granularity.

Attachments: onboarding_form_v2.pdf (filled), sku_catalog.xlsx (vendor SKUs)

Would appreciate procurement's guidance on the purchase ref issuance cadence and any temporary spend caps so we can schedule our provisioning.

Best,
Jacqueline Vega
Head of Partnerships
ClearEdge Analytics
(attachment: onboarding_form_v2.pdf)
(attachment: sku_catalog.xlsx)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jacqueline Vega <jacqueline@clearedge.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:51:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — allocation and PO guidance

Hi Jacqueline — thanks for sending these. Welcome aboard. Quick plan: 

1) Procurement ops will create a provisional purchase reference we can use to start provisioning for the pilot.
2) We'll allocate a provisional spend cap of $15,000 for the pilot phase and hold the remainder in a staged release up to $45,000 contingent on the pilot acceptance review.
3) We need a one-off SKU remap for two catalog lines that don't match our unit-of-measure (UoM) expectations — see the PO-ALLOC.csv I attached with suggested mapping flags where I saw issues.

Priyom / Monica — can you pick this up and issue a provisional PO (PDF) and confirm whether we should split the disputed line into two ledger lines (usage + support) or ask ClearEdge to break them out before invoicing?

Jacqueline — if you can also send a CSV with vendor_SKU -> vendor_invoice_description (so we can compare fields), that will speed things up.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference
(attachment: PO-ALLOC.csv)
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Jacqueline Vega <jacqueline@clearedge.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Provisional PO issued — PUR-20270621-3381 (pilot allocation)

On Mon, Jun 21, 2027 at 09:51 AM Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com> wrote:
> Priyom / Monica — can you pick this up and issue a provisional PO (PDF) and confirm whether we should split the disputed line into two ledger lines (usage + support) or ask ClearEdge to break them out before invoicing?

Hi all — Procurement ops created a provisional purchase reference for the pilot: PUR-20270621-3381.

Summary: 
- Provisional spend cap: USD 15,000 (pilot).
- Holdback schedule: 3-stage release to reach USD 45,000 after pilot acceptance (details in the PO PDF).
- Line item note: vendor SKU vendor_SKU_4729 submitted as a bundled charge (monthly + onboarding) — our ledger requires separate accounting for recurring usage (SKU-U) and one-time onboarding (SKU-O).

Action items for Jacqueline / ClearEdge: 
- Please confirm whether you want us to split the single invoice line into two ledger lines (we can do that and map internally) OR provide a revised invoice with two lines.
- Provide the vendor_SKU->invoice_description CSV to finalize mapping.

Attached: provisional_po_PUR-20270621-3381.pdf (provisionally issued)

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
(attachment: provisional_po_PUR-20270621-3381.pdf)
From: Jacqueline Vega <jacqueline@clearedge.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Provisional PO issued — PUR-20270621-3381 (pilot allocation)

Thanks Priyom — we can provide a remap CSV and prefer Redwood to split the line on your side to avoid re-issuing our billing system right now. Attached is SKU_remap_request.csv that shows vendor_SKU_4729 -> SKU-U (usage) and SKU-O (onboarding) suggested breakouts, plus suggested unit prices for each sub-line so totals still match the provisional PO.

Please confirm once you perform the split and update the ledger entries so our finance team can crosswalk at month-end. Also confirm whether the staged release from $15k -> $45k requires a separate PO for the staged bands or if Redwood will manage it as amendments to PUR-20270621-3381.

Best,
Jacqueline Vega
Head of Partnerships
ClearEdge Analytics
(attachment: SKU_remap_request.csv)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Sent: Thu, Jun 24, 2027 16:10:00 -07:00

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Subject: Re: Provisional PO issued — PUR-20270621-3381 (pilot allocation)

Thanks, Jacqueline — we'll split the line internally and post the ledger update this afternoon. I will follow up once the internal split is live and share the accounting reference IDs.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
